apod.explanation: Don't judge a galaxy by its size. This Hubble image shows NGC 4449, a dwarf galaxy about a tenth the size of the Milky Way — yet dwarf galaxies are the most common type in the universe. NGC 4449 and similar dwarfs are missing more oxygen than models predict, suggesting their stellar winds and supernovae are surprisingly effective at blowing away oxygen and other heavy elements. These tiny galaxies may play a big role in spreading the building blocks of stars, planets and life throughout the universe.
apod.title: NGC 4449: Small Galaxy, Big Impact

breaking.fact: After Tuesday's hot inflation print, traders put a December Fed rate hike at about 90%, and Goldman Sachs now expects hikes in December and March — a sharp reversal from the cuts priced in just weeks ago.
breaking.headline: December Fed rate hike now looks near-certain after hot inflation print

breaking.fact: Two days of US-Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi ended with a large prisoner exchange agreed in principle and nothing else signed — no ceasefire, no joint statement, no date for a next round. Envoys Kushner and Witkoff meet Putin in Moscow on Thursday, then Zelenskyy in Dublin.
breaking.headline: Abu Dhabi talks end with prisoner swap agreed, no ceasefire

items.body: Iran's parliament speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said Wednesday the Strait of Hormuz will never return to its pre-war status, while Tehran waits for a US response to seven conditions for reopening the waterway. Foreign Minister Araghchi said the strait could reopen within two days if the conditions are met; US Central Command says nearly 150 ships have been turned away under the continuing naval blockade.
items.headline: Tehran: Hormuz will never return to pre-war status

items.body: Iran's navy said Wednesday a tanker caught fire after striking a mine in a restricted area east of the strait, giving no ship name and no casualty figures; the claim has no independent confirmation. UKMTO separately logged an overnight tanker incident with details still unconfirmed. The International Maritime Organization counts 133 confirmed incidents in the strait and wider Middle East as of Nov 10, with 25 seafarer fatalities.
items.headline: Iran navy claims another tanker hit a mine; UKMTO logs incident

hormuz.stats: Traffic & shares (latest verified): AIS-visible commercial traffic is running about 8% of normal — 6.9 ships a day over the past week (18 tankers) against 84.8 before the crisis. EIA puts Hormuz oil flows at 4.9M bbl/day in Q2 2026, down from 21.6M in Q4 2025; the IEA estimates ~20M bbl/day transited in 2025, about a quarter of global seaborne oil trade. China takes ~42% and India ~13% of strait crude throughput; ~90% of Iran's oil exports go to China. The EIA warns vessel-tracking data have become less reliable during the conflict.

marketsNote: Wednesday's rebound held into the close: S&P 500 +1.31% to 7,619.38, Nasdaq +1.60% to 25,466.19, Dow +0.49% to 52,486.49 as CoreWeave (+25%) and Nvidia (+2.9%) revive the AI trade and chip stocks jump — the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index +5.66%. Oil edges up (WTI $86.47, Brent $92.64) as Hormuz attacks keep a risk premium in crude; the VIX falls to 17.49. The bond market was closed for Veterans Day, so the 10-year yield is Tuesday's 4.98%.

space.body: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman said the Orion spacecraft 'will clearly live on beyond SLS,' signalling a long-term future for the capsule on other launch vehicles after the Space Launch System retires — Blue Origin's New Glenn 9x4 is reported able to support Orion flights to the Moon. Orion is being readied to carry the Artemis III crew for most of their mission in 2027.
space.headline: Orion will clearly live on beyond SLS, NASA chief signals

space.body: Amino acids from asteroid Bennu — sampled by NASA's OSIRIS-REx — and from the Murchison meteorite formed through the same process but originated in different parts of the solar system, researchers report in Communications Earth & Environment, based on new isotope measurements. The pristine Bennu sample, free of Earth contamination, is reshaping ideas about where life's building blocks formed.
space.headline: Bennu asteroid organics formed far from where they were found

space.body: Researchers at King's College London, UCL and the Francis Crick Institute report in Nature that correcting a single error in how the UNC13A gene is produced restored communication between human neurons in lab models of motor neuron disease. A similar drug approach is already in human clinical trials in the UK, Europe and China.
space.headline: Drug restores neuron communication in motor neuron disease models

weekInBrief.body: House Republicans elected Jim Jordan as their next leader on Wednesday, following the party's midterm defeat — he takes over the caucus as the new Congress takes shape.

weekInBrief.body: Four million workers struck across Spain on Wednesday over housing costs, in the country's first general strike in 14 years — a sign of how housing affordability has become a top political issue in Europe.
weekInBrief.headline: Four million workers strike in Spain over housing
